view_frame: The drawing presents a TOP (XY) view and an END SECTION view. The TOP view shows the handle's path in the XY plane. The END SECTION shows the circular cross-section of the handle. The Z-axis represents the thickness of the handle (perpendicular to the XY plane).

features.placement: The path consists of two straight segments and one semicircular arc. The straight segments are parallel to the Y-axis. The arc connects the two straight segments. The centreline of the arc has a radius of 20 mm. The straight legs have a length of 30 mm. The entire path is centred in the XY plane.
features.evidence: The TOP view shows a U-shaped path with a semicircular bend and two straight legs. The text 'Bend centreline R20; straight legs 30 mm' confirms the dimensions. The END SECTION shows a circle with 'diameter 8 mm'.

connections: The two straight segments are tangent to the semicircular arc at their endpoints.
edit_rules: Changing the bend centreline radius will change the overall width of the handle.
Changing the straight leg length will change the overall height of the handle.
Changing the diameter will change the thickness of the handle.
